## Checklist

Before submitting this PR, please ensure:

### Code Quality
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines (Black for Python, ESLint for JS)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have removed any console.log statements or debug code

### Documentation
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (README, CLAUDE.md, etc.) to reflect my changes
- [ ] I have added docstrings/comments to new functions and classes
- [ ] I have updated type hints (Python) or prop types (React)

### Testing
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have tested on multiple browsers (for frontend changes)
- [ ] I have tested with real audio hardware (if applicable)

### Dependencies
- [ ] I have updated requirements.txt or package.json if I added new dependencies
- [ ] I have verified that new dependencies are necessary and well-maintained

### Git
- [ ] My commits are clear and descriptive
- [ ] I have rebased my branch on the latest main/master
- [ ] I have resolved all merge conflicts
